info.title: OMS Load Components Service
info.description: This service fills, empties, or reports on the TD/OMS object file for a selected application, environment, library, object, and object type. Use it to refresh the TD/OMS object database from IBM i objects, IFS files or supported 4GL objects, and use the job status endpoint to check batch processing results. All operations require a bearer JWT token.

servers.description: Configurable TD/OMS endpoint for the Fill Object File service.

host.description: Host name of the IBM i system or gateway that serves the API.

library.description: TD/OMS product library used in the API path.

protocol.description: Transport protocol used to call the service.

port.description: HTTP or HTTPS port on which the service listens.

host.description: Host name of the IBM i system or gateway that serves the API.

library.description: TD/OMS product library used in the API path.

protocol.description: Transport protocol used to call the service.

port.description: HTTP or HTTPS port on which the service listens.

/fillObject.description: Starts a Fill Object File run for normal IBM i objects, 4GL objects, or both. The request selects the application, environment, object source, and processing options.

post.description: Runs the Fill Object File process. Depending on the processing options, the service can load selected objects into TD/OMS, remove selected objects from TD/OMS, rebuild only object relations, or produce a report without changing stored object information.

requestBody.description: Selection and processing options for the Fill Object File run.

200.description: The Fill Object File request was accepted or completed successfully. Check status and messages for details.

400.description: The request could not be processed because one or more supplied values are invalid.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

/jobStatus.summary: Get Fill Object File job status
/jobStatus.description: Returns a count of Fill Object File jobs by state: active, waiting on a job queue, and completed with output available on an output queue.

get.summary: Get Fill Object File job status
get.description: Retrieves current Fill Object File job counts so clients can monitor batch processing after a fill request.

200.description: Fill Object File job status was retrieved successfully.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

messageFile.description: IBM i message file that contains the message definition.

messageId.description: IBM i or TD/OMS message identifier.

messageType.description: Single-character message severity or type code, for example E for error or N for normal information.

messageData.description: Substitution data used to build the returned message text.

field.description: Request field related to the message, when the message applies to a specific input value.

messageText.description: Human-readable message text including cause and recovery information when available.

extendedMessage.description: A TD/OMS or IBM i message returned by the service.

applicationCode.description: TD/OMS application code that contains the objects to process.

environmentCode.description: Environment within the selected application. Use *ALL to select all environments in the application.

routeCode.description: Route used when selecting IFS objects. Use *ALL for all routes or *NONE when routes must not be used. When routeCode is *NONE, objectLibrary may not be *NONE.

objectLibrary.description: IBM i object library to scan. Use *ALL for all selected libraries or *NONE when libraries must not be used. When objectLibrary is *NONE, routeCode may not be *NONE.

objectCode.description: Object name selection. Use *ALL for all objects, a generic object name, or a wildcard pattern supported by TD/OMS.

objectType.description: IBM i object type selection. Use *ALL to process all object types selected by the other request fields.

objectAttribute.description: Object attribute selection. Use *ALL to process all object attributes selected by the other request fields.

request.description: Request body used to select objects and control how the Fill Object File process runs.

status.description: Return status. *NORM means normal completion; *TERM means the request ended with an error and messages should be inspected.

jobName.description: IBM i job name that handled the request.

userId.description: IBM i user profile under which the job ran.

messages.description: Messages returned by the Fill Object File process.

response.description: Result of a Fill Object File request, including the job identity and returned messages.

processingMode.description: Execution environment for the command. *INTERACTIVE runs in the current job; *FORCEBATCH submits the work to batch using job description OMSJOBD.

processingMethod.description: Action to perform. *FILL loads selected objects into TD/OMS; *EMPTY removes selected objects from TD/OMS; *REPORT compares TD/OMS data with the current object state without storing changes.

processOnlyRelations.description: Controls whether only object relationships are rebuilt. *NO fully loads the selected objects; *YES rebuilds only relationships for the selection.

objectAndOr4GLGroup.description: Object group to process. *BOTH processes normal IBM i and 4GL objects; *OBJECT processes normal IBM i objects; *GROUP processes 4GL objects.

typeCA2ESelection.description: Synon/CA 2E selection mode. *ANY selects all areas, *AREA selects the area named in cA2EObjectCode, *ANYSYS also includes internal system objects, and *AREASYS combines area selection with internal system objects.

cA2EObjectCode.description: Synon/CA 2E object or area selection. Use *ALL for all selected Synon objects, or provide a name when the selection mode requires a specific area or object.

cA2EOwningObject.description: Owning Synon/CA 2E object. Use *ALLOBJ when cA2EObjectCode is *ALL, *ANY to skip owning object selection, or provide a specific owning object name.

processingOptions.description: Processing options for execution mode, fill method, relation rebuilding, and 4GL object selection.

totalNumberOfJobs.description: Total number of Fill Object File jobs found across all reported states.

activeJobs.description: Number of Fill Object File jobs currently active.

jobsOnJobQueue.description: Number of Fill Object File jobs waiting on a job queue.

jobsOnOutputQueue.description: Number of completed Fill Object File jobs with output waiting on an output queue.

jobStatusResponse.description: Counts of Fill Object File jobs by processing state, plus the related TD/OMS status message.

fillObject.description: Example request that fills normal IBM i objects for application XMP across all environments and libraries.

fillObjectFor4GLObject.description: Example request that fills all selected 4GL objects for application XMP.

fillObjectResponse200.description: Successful response showing normal completion and an informational TD/OMS message.

messages.messageText: 1 objects added, 0 changed and 0 removed for environment *DEV. Cause: The fill object file request has been processed. Recovery: No recovery is necessary.

fillObjectResponse400.description: Error response returned when the supplied application code does not exist.

messages.messageText: The application code XXXXX does not exist. Cause: You have specified an application code that does not exist. Recovery: Specify an existing application code and try the request again.

unauthorizedResponse401.description: Response returned when the bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

value.messageText: Unauthorized or expired token. Please login again.

jobStatusResponse200.description: Successful response showing active, queued, and completed Fill Object File jobs.

message.messageText: 0 out of 26 Fill Object File jobs are active. Cause: Out of 26 Fill Object File jobs, 0 jobs are active, 0 are on job queue, and 26 are on output queue. Recovery: No action is required.

JWT.description: JWT bearer token returned by the OMS login API or an equivalent authorized token.
